questions.passage: The Diamond Hotel is a quarantine hotel. It has seventy rooms for guests. Every room can only have one guest. This line graph shows how many of the rooms were occupied during 2020 and 2021. 70 60 50 40 30 20 10 0 Jan Feb March April May June July Aug Sept Oct Nov Dec
questions.subject: english

teaching.kind: 雙年度折線圖：先辨圖例，再定位月份
knowledge: 原圖虛線空心圓代表 2020，實線實心圓代表 2021；橫軸是月份，縱軸是已入住的房間數。題目每房只有一位客人，因此所求人數等於該年月的入住間數。
steps: 圈出 May, 2021，而不是把兩年的 May 合併。
依圖例選 2021 的實線實心圓。
找到 May 上方的實心點，對應縱軸 30；同月 2020 的空心點為 50，不能混讀。
每間一人，所以有 30 位客人，選 A。
reasons: 2021 年五月實心點為 30，與所求年月及單位均相符。
40 對應其他月份的實線讀值，並非五月。
50 是五月 2020 年的空心點，讀錯年度。
60 不是題目指定的 2021 年五月讀值。

transfer.prompt: 某原創圖的實線代表今年、虛線代表去年；六月分別為 36、48 間入住。旅館共 70 間，每房一人。今年六月入住與空房各多少？
transfer.answer: 入住 36 人，空房 34 間。
steps: 空房為 70−36=34；不可把去年 48 代入。

options.A: Producing a video about student life and special education.
options.B: Creating a video specially for students who love the school.
options.C: Making a short video on how the school is special to oneself.

questions.groupTitle: 根據以下公告,回答第 33-34 題
questions.passage: Karano High School Video Competition Competition Rules ENTRY GUIDELINES 1. General • Participation is open only to students who are now studying in Karano High School. • Only one video is allowed per student/team. • Submit your video by September 30th, 2022. 2. Video Production • Videos must be one minute in length. • Videos must be original; use of material must be permitted by law. 3. Content • Must address the theme, “Karano High School - A Special Place!” describing what you love about this school and what it is like to be a student here. • Must be suitable for all audiences. JUDGING CRITERIA Judges will give points based on creativity, production quality, and how well the theme is presented. PRIZES Results will be announced on December 1st, 2022 during the School Anniversary Celebration, and three cash prizes totaling NT$10,000 will be awarded.
questions.subject: english

teaching.kind: 公告的主題、限制與活動日期分層
knowledge: 公告同時包含參賽資格、影片長度、主題、公布日與獎金。問 competition about 時，應讀 Content 的主題條款，不能用公布日期或長度取代。
steps: 題問競賽內容，而非誰能報名或何時公布。
Content 指定 Karano High School—A Special Place，說明學校對自己的特別之處。
C 將此意改寫成 how the school is special to oneself。
其他選項改成特殊教育、受眾或校慶當天拍攝，均超出內容要求，故選 C。
reasons: special education 是特殊教育，非學校對自己的特殊意義。
把影片主題錯成製作給某群學生觀看。
保留自己的學校何以特別的主題。
校慶是公布結果的時間，不是指定拍攝活動。

transfer.prompt: 公告寫「主題：我最喜歡的校園角落；12/1公布結果」。能否推出一定要拍12/1校慶？
transfer.answer: 不能；主題與公布日期是不同欄位。
steps: 依主題準備作品，不增加未寫的限制。

options.D: Cuzco is about 3 hours on foot to Machu Picchu.

questions.groupTitle: 閱讀下文,回答第 35-37 題
questions.passage: To: Molly From: Jim <jim888@gmailer.com> Subject: My volunteer trip 16th, July Sat. 12:55 P.M. Hi Molly, We arrived in Cuzco last Friday. Can you imagine? This city sits at 3,400 meters above sea level and has a population of 350,000. It’s near the Andes Mountains, and about three hours by train to Machu Picchu. At the end of the four-week volunteer trip, we’re going to visit Machu Picchu. I can’t wait to see the mysterious Inca city! Here, we all stay with local families. My host family is wonderful. I eat meals with them and speak Spanish with them. I also help them around the house. From Monday to Saturday, we go to a local school to work with the teachers and help them with anything they need. We teach English, and help with art, music, and sports. Also, we help repair the school, such as putting in new windows and painting the classrooms. I feel exhausted sometimes. However, when I see the children’s happy faces, I know that I have made the right decision. How’s your trip? Jim To: Jim <jim888@gmailer.com> From: Molly Subject: Re: My volunteer trip 17th, July Sun. 10:00 A.M. Hi Jim, It’s good to hear that you enjoy what you are doing there. I was worried that you wouldn’t get used to the weather and the hard work in Cuzco. My art trip starts from Louvre museum, Paris. We are now here to see the art display of Leonardo da Vinci, an Italian artist. His paintings are great. Tomorrow, we’ll leave for the British Museum in London. Talk to you then. BTW, don’t forget to share pictures of Machu Picchu. Take care! Molly

questions.passage: Carbon dioxide (CO ) is good at holding in heat from the Sun, and even a small increase 2 of the gas in the atmosphere can cause Earth to get even warmer. Carbon capture, usage and storage (CCUS) is about different technologies that can keep CO produced by factories and 2 power plants from causing global warming. The idea is simple, and there are only a few main steps in the process. The first step is about trapping carbon emissions from factory chimneys. For instance, a filter can be placed in the chimney, so that the carbon is trapped and it cannot go out into the atmosphere. Then, the gas is piped to places where it can be stored or used. If stored underground, it cannot contribute to the climate crisis. If used, for instance, it can help grow greenhouse plants or make soda drinks. While CCUS projects can clearly benefit the environment, these projects are not straightforward as there are many issues to be dealt with, such as maintaining the storage site, which have slowed start-ups of CCUS projects worldwide. Thus, with only a few CCUS projects operating now, there still aren’t enough to seriously help with the world’s carbon emissions. Early forerunners in this technology are the US, Canada, and Norway. The good news is that CCUS has now gained momentum in other countries, where 30 new projects have begun in the past three years. The International Energy Agency says there must be many more to keep carbon emissions from heating the world too much.
